newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's GOCTIC sets US$50 mln FRN issue.
newsitem.headline: China's GOCTIC sets US$50 mln FRN issue.

text.p: Guangdong Overseas Chinese Trust and Investment Corp's (GOCTIC) US$50 million floating rate note issue was now in general syndication, bankers said on Friday.
They said the facility has three tranches.
The US$20 million tranche A has a final maturity of three years. It pays a coupon of 55 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate and a selling concession of 65 basis points.
The US$15 million tranche B has a final maturity of four years and pays a coupon of 60 basis points. The selling concession is 70 basis points.
The US$15 million tranche C has a final maturity of five years and pays a coupon of 65 basis points. The selling concession is 75 basis points.

Fees are 65 basis points for co-arranger and co-lead managers committing US$5 million or above, 60 basis points for senior managers committing US$3-4 million, and 55 basis points for managers comitting US$2 million.
Arrangers are BZW Asia, CommerzBank, Korea Development Bank and Sakura Finance Asia.
